stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 41 pts from Glen White, a round that would poll three votes in any grandstand in the country.

stories.title: Case Closed
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 3 - that'll do nicely

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 20 coming home vs 10 out

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 214 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Good to see William Coghlan up from Royal Sydney GC, and we hope the greens were kind.

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 17 & 18 - this is momentum

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Big Finish
stories.detail: 10 points on the last three - closed the deal in style

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 12 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 17, 1-pointer on hole 18

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 20, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 6 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Out of the Blocks
stories.detail: 9 points in the first three - a statement start

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 6 straight two-pointers on holes 3-8

stories.title: The Long One-Pointer
stories.detail: 5 1-pointers straight at some point - it happened and it hurt

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 17 on the front, 10 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Committed to the One-Pointer
stories.detail: 9 1-pointers - every hole is a 1-pointer and that is the plan

stories.title: The One-Point Cascade
stories.detail: 6 1-pointers straight - the handicap is having a moment

stories.title: The Course Wins Again
stories.detail: 3 straight on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the handicap card stays in the bag

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 5, 6 & 7 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 2, 3 & 4 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 5 & 6 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: John Michel slid from 5th to 15th, same side as always, just a flat week after the bye.
